svg.title: Evaluate the selection process, not its best inner score.

cc:Work.dc:title: Evaluate the selection process, not its best inner score.
cc:Work.dc:description: 455 development records · 5 outer folds × 3 inner folds × 2 repeats · 114 test records excluded Source: pinned UCI WDBC; every scaler refit within its fitting partition. Selection counts: Logistic C=1: 10. Dots are fold outcomes, not independent studies. Dotted lines are pooled out-of-fold loss within each repeat, not confidence limits.
